headline: US futures point to higher open as tech leads on global earnings optimism and Brent nears $110 ahead of data and heavy earnings slate
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) +0.23%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) +0.04%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) +0.71%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) -0.10% indicate a modestly higher US open led by technology
- Asian equities advanced overnight with Japan’s Nikkei (@NKD) up over 1% and MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan gaining 1.5% on improved earnings sentiment
- European futures edged higher as risk appetite stabilized following recent technology sector volatility
- Brent crude (@QA) climbed to around $110 per barrel, extending the recent upswing in energy prices
- A heavy pre-market earnings slate features Abbott Laboratories (ABT), AT&T (T), NextEra Energy (NEE), Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO), Philip Morris (PM), Danaher (DHR), CME Group (CME), Elevance Health (ELV), and Moody's (MCO)
- After the close, earnings are due from Tesla (TSLA), Meta Platforms (META), IBM (IBM), and Lam Research (LRCX)
- US economic data today include MBA mortgage applications at 7:00 AM ET and EIA crude oil inventories at 10:30 AM ET, while UK CPI data already released showed higher-than-expected inflation
- Tesla (TSLA) gains about 2% pre-market after forming independent director committees to explore a merger, while Lam Research (LRCX) rises about 2.6% ahead of after-close earnings and Danaher (DHR) slips about 1.1%
